class.name: ResourceCacheServer
class.brief_description: The caches on disk as a whole, kept within the player's maximum size and the disk's free space.
class.description: Every [ResourceCache] keeps its files under [member root]. An entry is what a cache keeps under one path: its file, the file's hash and the directory of files it writes beside it ([method ResourceCache.get_file_path]). The server knows when each entry was last used, across sessions, and how large it is. When the caches grow past what they may take ([method budget_get]) - the player's maximum size ([code]reloaded/cache/max_size[/code] [lb]bytes[rb]), or less when the disk's free space would fall under a reserve the caches never take - the least recently used entries are removed first. An entry used in this session is never removed: what is streamed or loaded lazily reads its files later. The caches are trimmed when the server is created, before anything reads them, after every entry a cache writes, and when the player changes the maximum size. The default maximum size is a share of the disk's free space as the game starts, at most 20 GB, and always one of [method max_size_get_choices]. Nothing is trimmed in the editor: it shares the game's user directory and would remove what a running game uses.

method.name: budget_get
method.description: Returns what the caches may take [lb]bytes[rb]: [param max_size], or less when the disk's [param free_space] would fall under the reserve the caches never take while they hold [param used]. A [param max_size] of [constant MAX_SIZE_UNLIMITED] leaves only the reserve. Never less than 0.

method.name: cache_clear
method.description: Removes every file under [param directory] of [member root], and the whole [member root] for an empty [param directory]. [method ResourceCache.clear] and "Clear cache" ([method GameDataServer.cache_clear]) go through it.

method.name: cache_trim
method.description: Removes the least recently used entries not used in this session until the caches fit what they may take ([method budget_get]). Does nothing in the editor.

method.name: max_size_get_choices
method.description: Returns the maximum sizes the player chooses from [lb]bytes[rb], smallest first, with [constant MAX_SIZE_UNLIMITED] last.

members.member: Where every cache keeps its files. Another root (the tests') is measured at once as a new session: nothing in it counts as used yet, and the previous root is left as it is.

constants.constant: The maximum size that sets no maximum: only the disk's free space limits the caches.
